sentences.en: The musician began to play the violin on the stage.
sentences.zh: 这位音乐家开始在舞台上拉小提琴。

sentences.en: People in the back row craned to see the stage.
sentences.zh: 后排的人伸长脖子想看清楚舞台上的情况。

sentences.en: The next stage was to enter a good arts school.
sentences.zh: 接下来的阶段就是进入一所好的艺术学校了。

senses.zh: 适于上演；举行；乘驿车旅行
